jobs.title: Hotel Loss Prevention & Safety Officer
jobs.description: Omni Hotels & Resorts in Fort Worth, TX is seeking a Loss Prevention Officer to safeguard guests and staff, enforce hotel policies, and document incidents in the format specified by leadership. Responsibilities include patrolling property, observing and reporting on assignments, maintaining records, and communicating via radio equipment, while upholding a professional appearance and demeanor.

jobs.title: Loss Prevention Intern - Protect Assets & Improve Security
jobs.description: A leading global e-commerce company is seeking a Loss Prevention Intern for Summer 2026 in Fort Worth, Texas. This 10-week internship offers college students the chance to lead security initiatives in a Fulfillment Center while developing skills in asset protection and security services. Key responsibilities include assisting with theft investigations and improving operational efficiency. Successful interns may receive full-time employment offers after completing the program.

jobs.description:
Silver Creek Materials is seeking a part-time Loss Prevention Specialist to protect assets, people, and operations at our Fort Worth site. You will patrol, monitor access, respond to alarms, and partner with management to enforce safety policies in a busy logistics environment.

Ideal candidates have a high school diploma, a valid driver's license, and the ability to work weekends and variable hours outdoors with reliability and strong communication skills.
